summary: This is an 8-K filing by Quantum Cyber N.V. (the registrant) reporting that it received a letter from Nasdaq confirming it has regained compliance with the minimum bid price rule (Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2)). The filing notes that the closing bid price of the company's ordinary shares had been at or greater than $1.00 per share for 10 consecutive business days, closing a prior deficiency notice. This is a routine compliance update and does not represent a special-situation corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The filing contains no deal terms, board recommendations, or structural changes beyond the compliance notice.
